description: Cloudflare R2 behind the shared storage port. Presigning via aws4fetch rather than the AWS SDK — it is a few kilobytes and does exactly one thing. Bucket is private; downloads go through an authorized redirect, never a public URL.

env.name: R2_ACCOUNT_ID
env.note: Cloudflare account id — the subdomain of your r2.cloudflarestorage.com endpoint.

env.name: R2_BUCKET
env.note: Private bucket, nf-{slug}-{env}-assets. Previews MUST use their own, or disable uploads.
